issue_context.title: Blueprint: domain mobile_app notify messages not resolved within the scope of a repeat action
issue_context.body:
## The problem

When I started to work on my blueprint: https://community.home-assistant.io/t/nagging-repeatable-alert-notification-send-to-mobile-and-optional-other-actions/256392 I stumbled across the following issue.

Expressions defined in an input variable are not being resolved when provided to the mobile_app notification within the scope of a repeat action. I'm referring to the following syntax which IMHO was introduced for the blueprints. Thus, my guess is, it's more related to blueprints than to the actual mobile_app companion integrations.

```yaml
 - domain: mobile_app
   type: notify
   device_id: !input notify_device
   message: !input message
```

How to reproduce:

1. Use the blueprint below
2. Define an input message including expressions such as: `"Hello World: {{entity_name}} is triggered {{repeat_count}} times"` or use the default
3.  Trigger the entity (must be a boolean)
4.  Observe the log statement and your mobile device notifications
  -  All Logging statements are resolved as expected
  -  Thei first mobile app notification is resolved as expected
  -  The subsequential mobile app notifications  (send from within the repeat loop) aren't  ->  "Hello World: is triggered times"

## Environment

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue:   2021.1.4
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known):  
- Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core):  iOS
- Integration causing this issue:  automation
- Link to integration documentation on our website:  https://www.home-assistant.io/docs/automation/using_blueprints/

## Problem-relevant `sample-blueprint.yaml`

```yaml
blueprint:
  name: Sample Blueprint
  description: ""
  domain: automation
  source_url: https://gist.github.com/pavax/sample
  input:
    my_entity:
      name: My Entity
      description: "A entity that triggers the automation"
      selector:
        entity:

    notify_device:
      name: Device to notify
      description: "Device needs to run the official Home Assistant app to receive notifications."
      selector:
        device:
          integration: mobile_app

    message:
      name: My Message 
      description: 'Default: "Sample-Blueprint-Debugg: {{ entity_name }} triggered {{repeat_count}} times"'
      default: "Sample-Blueprint-Debugg: {{ entity_name }} triggered {{repeat_count}} times"

mode: restart
max_exceeded: silent

trigger:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input my_entity
    to: 'on'

variables:
  my_entity: !input my_entity
  entity_name: "{{states[my_entity].name  }}"
  message: !input message
  repeat_count: "0"

action:
  - service: system_log.write
    data:
      # OK-Case: Expressions within the message variable are resolved in logs
      message: !input message
      level: warning
  - domain: mobile_app
    type: notify
    device_id: !input notify_device
    # OK-Case: Expressions within the message variable are resolved in the mobile_app notifaction
    message: !input message
  - delay: "00:00:05"
  - repeat:
      count: 2
      sequence:
          - variables:
              repeat_count: "{{ repeat.index}}"
          - service: system_log.write
            data:
              # OK-Case: Expressions within the message variable are resolved in logs
              message: !input message
              level: warning
          - domain: mobile_app
            type: notify
            device_id: !input notify_device
            # Bug: Expressions defined within the message variable are not resolved in the mobile_app notifaction
            message: !input message
          - delay: "00:00:05"
```

## Traceback/Error logs

No error

## Additional information
